test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.

I have left it to his __discretion__ to accept or decline my offer.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"discretion"** means the quality of behaving or speaking in such a way as to avoid causing offense or revealing confidential information. It also refers to the freedom to decide what should be done in a particular situation. (विवेक)

 
 
• **Example: **She knew she could rely on his **discretion** to keep the information private.
 
 
 
• **"Inattention"** refers to lack of attention; disregard. It is the opposite of being attentive and careful. (अवधान)
 
 
• **Example: **His** inattention** in class often led to missing important details.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'discretion' is 'inattention'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Judgement** (निर्णय): The ability to make considered decisions or come to sensible conclusions.

 
 
• **Example:** His judgement in critical situations is highly valued.
 
 
 
• **Wisdom** (बुद्धिमत्ता): The quality of having experience, knowledge, and good judgement.
 
 
• **Example: **His wisdom is often sought in difficult matters.
 
 
 
• **Calculation** (गणना): The process of using mathematics; careful planning.
 
 
• **Example:** The calculation of risks is essential for any business venture.
